title: The Blocktaker
description:
This mod adds all of The Caretaker's "Everywhere At The End Of Time" and "An Empty Bliss Beyond This World" songs to the game as music discs.

This mod adds: 
63 music discs only for creative mode.
Paintings representing each EATEOT stage and AEBBTW.
body:
This mod adds all of The Caretaker's "Everywhere At The End Of Time" and "An Empty Bliss Beyond This World" songs to the game as music discs.

This mod adds:  \
63 music discs only for creative mode. \
Paintings:  \
Beaten Frowns - Ivan Seal \
Pittor Pickgown in Khatheinstersper - Ivan Seal \
Hag - Ivan Seal \
Giltsholder - Ivan Seal \
Eptitranxisticemestionscers Desending - Ivan Seal \
Necrotomigaud - Ivan Seal \
Happy In Spite - Ivan Seal

Discs: \
A1 – It’s just a burning memory \

A4 – Childishly fresh eyes \
A5 – Slightly bewildered \
A6 – Things that are beautiful and transient \

All you are going to want to do is get back there \
Moments of sufficient lucidity \
The great hidden sea of the unconscious \
Libet’s delay \

An empty bliss beyond this World \

A relationship with the sublime \

Pared back to the minimal \

Camaraderie at arms length \
The sublime is disappointingly elusive
